correctness.rationale: Cyclic windows biject with labeled edges of order-(n-1) de Bruijn digraph. A q^n-2 edge-simple closed tour has two deleted balanced edges; every balanced two-edge digraph is two loops (distinct constants) or an alternating directed 2-cycle. BEST gives cyclic tours via rooted directed arborescences times factorial degree product, reduced by (q-1)^2. Loops do not change the directed Laplacian. Deleting the alternating 2-cycle gives Laplacian rank-one update L-ww^T. Since the uniform de Bruijn shift satisfies P^(n-1)=J and w^TP^kw=2(-1/q)^k, determinant lemma gives exact factor (q-1+2(-1/q)^(n-1))/(q+1), positive for q≥3. Multiply by binom(q,2). Distinct length-n windows guarantee aperiodicity, so no extra rotational stabilizer. Independently recomputed Laplacian cofactors for seven (q,n) cases including q3 n3 and q4 n3; direct complete ternary n2 necklace enumeration matches 24, with constant/alternating split 18/6. Infinite result rests on graph proof.
residual_risks: Only q≥3, n≥2, labeled alphabet, cyclic rotation quotient, exactly two missing windows.
